stories.title: Bexar County Sheriff's Office seeks public's help locating missing 26-year-old woman
stories.summary: The Bexar County Sheriff's Office is asking for the public's help locating Yadira Labrada Rodriguez, who was last seen Tuesday evening.

stories.title: Suspect arrested after alleged shooting, pursuit involving DPS trooper in downtown San Antonio
stories.summary: A Texas DPS trooper discharged a weapon while pursuing a suspect who allegedly fired at a victim in downtown San Antonio early Friday, police said.

stories.title: Texas HS band raises $350,000 to stay in NYC for rescheduled Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
stories.summary: More than 500 band and color guard students will stay for Saturday’s parade after supporters met the goal to cover unexpected travel costs.

stories.title: Neighbors kick in door to rescue elderly couple as Thanksgiving fire burns North Texas homes
stories.summary: A fire that started at a home business in the back of a house spread to a neighboring home early Thanksgiving morning in Fort Worth, officials said.

stories.title: A truck driver and his mystery passenger died in 1991. Now, 35 years later, there's a breakthrough
stories.summary: The unidentified passenger was known as "Helen Doe" for decades before DNA testing revealed her name.

stories.title: 'Operation Home Cooking' helps give over 800 airmen a place to spend Thanksgiving
stories.summary: More than 400 families were sought to house the airmen for the holiday.

stories.title: K9 helps uncover more than 130 pounds of fentanyl, meth hidden in car at Arizona border
stories.summary: CBP says officers detained an 18-year-old driver after finding drugs concealed throughout her vehicle at the San Luis Port of Entry.

stories.title: Thanksgiving Day fire prompts second-story window escape in northwest Harris County, officials say
stories.summary: Two people escaped through a second-story window during a Thanksgiving Day house fire in northwest Harris County. No injuries were reported.

stories.title: Crews working to recover vehicle from bayou in south Harris County
stories.summary: Marine units are responding after a vehicle went off the road and into a bayou near South Sam Houston Parkway West and Buffalo Speedway.

stories.title: Dallas family escapes devastating Thanksgiving Day fire
stories.summary: As fire raced through the home on Bertrand Avenue, the Harper family abandoned everything, including their Thanksgiving meal.

stories.title: HCSO: Deputy shoots armed woman during mental health crisis call in NW Harris County
stories.summary: A 49-year-old woman was hospitalized after a Harris County deputy shot her while responding to a mental health crisis call on Thanksgiving.

stories.title: 'A little bit of joy': Dallas Animal Shelter dogs get a Thanksgiving feast as they wait for forever homes
stories.summary: Sponsored by Friends of Dallas Animal Services, the food is provided by Green Pet Supply.
